'''Kazuki Yao''' (Japanese: '''矢尾一樹''' ''Yao Kazuki'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Yao was born on June 17, 1959, in {{wp|Kanazawa}}, {{wp|Ishikawa Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}. He became a voice actor as an adult and led a long, prolific voice acting career, becoming known for a variety of roles in anime series. Yao voiced one of his best-known roles as [[Canalave City]] [[Gym Leader]] [[Byron]], during {{aniseries|DP}} of {{aniseries|PTS}}. Azuma is currently affiliated with Max Mix.
